FSC.singleResidual_covariance {n : ℕ} (G : FSC.Mat n) (hG : WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation G) (i : Fin n) :
  FSC.singleResidual G i * G * Matrix.transpose (FSC.singleResidual G i) = FSC.singleCov G i

FSC.singleResidual_indep_pin {n : ℕ} (G : FSC.Mat n) (hG : WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation G) (i : Fin n) :
  ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun (⇑(FSC.lin (FSC.singleResidual G i))) (fun x => x.ofLp i)
    (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 G)

FSC.map_singleResidual_pin {n : ℕ} (G : FSC.Mat n) (hG : WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation G) (i : Fin n) :
  MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun x => ((FSC.lin (FSC.singleResidual G i)) x, x.ofLp i))
      (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 G) =
    (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (FSC.singleCov G i)).prod (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1)

FSC.singleLaw_pin_ae {n : ℕ} (G : FSC.Mat n) (hG : WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation G) (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
  ∀ᵐ (x : FSC.Coord n) ∂FSC.singleLaw G i t, x.ofLp i = t

FSC.lintegral_singlePin {n : ℕ} (G : FSC.Mat n) (hG : WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation G) (i : Fin n)
  (f : FSC.Coord n × ℝ → ENNReal) (hf : Measurable f) :
  ∫⁻ (x : FSC.Coord n), f (x, x.ofLp i) ∂ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 G =
    ∫⁻ (t : ℝ), ∫⁻ (y : FSC.Coord n), f (y, t) ∂FSC.singleLaw G i t ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1

FSC.measure_singlePin {n : ℕ} (G : FSC.Mat n) (hG : WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation G) (i : Fin n) (s : Set (FSC.Coord n))
  (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
  (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 G) s =
    ∫⁻ (t : ℝ), (FSC.singleLaw G i t) s ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1
